note: The fuzzer-supplied L3 packet buffer is stored in the flow packet structure for parsing by the nDPI implementation.
For the crafted UDP packet, the input-controlled UDP length leaves a nonzero but one-byte payload length.
The payload pointer is derived from the same input packet and points to the single UDP payload byte.
A one-byte payload satisfies the generic protocol-selection guard because it only requires a nonzero payload.
The UDP Amazon Video detector enters its signature check without first requiring that the payload contain at least four bytes.
With only one payload byte available, reading the second signature byte accesses past the input-controlled payload buffer.
